lessons.lesson: Order was journaled open but never filled: the desk now verifies fills before journaling.
When the credit per width exceeds 0.30, watch for sudden moves; this trade lost, so cap credit.
Even with low IV, bear call spreads on SPY at delta ~0.20 still profit; keep using low‑IV entries.
High credit‑to‑width (≈0.29) bear calls can succeed if delta stays in the middle band; keep this ratio.
Continue selecting bear call spreads on QQQ with short‑call delta near 0.27 and modest credit; they work.
Skip bull put spreads on SPY when the market is near resistance; the trade lost.
Repeat using 1‑day bear call spreads on SPY with short‑call delta around 0.25 and low IV; they produced profit.
Do not open bull put spreads on QQQ when the index is showing upward momentum; wait for a pullback.
Avoid taking a 2‑point bear call spread with a credit above 0.27 per width; use tighter spreads or lower credit.
Order was journaled open but never filled: the desk now verifies fills before journaling.
